race.comment: NEWCOMBE (1) isn't what you'd call a prolific winner, having won just one of 23, but getting beaten just 1.4 lengths in a BM66 race last time out is a level of form not many here can compete with. A repeat of that run would have him as the horse to beat. RIPPA BUDDY (5) stuck on well last start to finish third over 1450m at Kilmore after showing good early speed. Hard to beat in this suitable race. TUDAYA (7) has been up for a long time, but the last couple of runs suggest he's holding up to the prep very well and there's no reason to think he won't be in the finish again. AKITU (3) missed the placings when resuming two runs back then didn't feature last start when 9 lengths away in eighth over 2000m at Naracoorte after being in contention on the turn. Can run an improved race third-up from a great gate. PALTINIAN (2) was out of the money when resuming from a spell last start over 1408m at Mildura, beaten 6 lengths, but fitter now and sure to run well.
